story.text: 노랗게 익은 감귤이 주렁주렁 매달린 농장 안, 용우가 능숙하게 가지를 젖히며 길을 터준다.
story.reading: no-rat-ge ik-eun gam-gyul-i ju-reong-ju-reong mae-dal-lin nong-jang an, yong-u-ga neung-suk-a-ge ga-ji-reul jeoch-i-myeo gil-eul teo-jun-da.
story.en: Inside an orchard hung heavy with ripe yellow tangerines, Yongwoo skillfully pushes branches aside to clear a path.

story.text: '여기 감귤이 제일 달아. 먹어봐라.' 손수 딴 감귤 하나를 까서 내밀어준다.
story.reading: yeo-gi gam-gyul-i je-il dal-a. meog-eo-bwa-ra. son-su ttan gam-gyul ha-na-reul kka-seo nae-mil-eo-jun-da.
story.en: 'The tangerines here are the sweetest. Try one.' He peels one he picked himself and holds it out to me.

story.text: 농장 주인 아주머니가 다가와 웃으며 묻는다. '어머, 이 총각 그 유명한 기장님 아니야? 규현 기장이랑 인기 양대산맥이라던.' 용우 표정이 순간 굳는다.
story.reading: nong-jang ju-in a-ju-meo-ni-ga da-ga-wa us-eu-myeo mut-neun-da. eo-meo, i chong-gak geu yu-myeong-han gi-jang-nim a-ni-ya? gyu-hyeon gi-jang-i-rang in-gi yang-dae-san-maeg-i-ra-deon. yong-u pyo-jeong-i sun-gan gud-neun-da.
story.en: The orchard owner, an ajumma, approaches with a smile. 'Oh my, aren't you that famous captain? The one people call the twin peaks of popularity with Captain Kyuhyun?' Yongwoo's expression stiffens instantly.

story.text: '양대산맥은 무슨, 저랑 걔랑 비교가 안 되는데요.' 재빨리 정정하지만 아무도 안 물어본 이야기를 혼자 더 이어간다. '인기투표 하면 제가 압도적일걸요.'
story.reading: yang-dae-san-maeg-eun mu-seun, jeo-rang gyae-rang bi-gyo-ga an doe-neun-de-yo. jae-ppal-li jeong-jeong-ha-ji-man a-mu-do an mul-eo-bon i-ya-gi-reul hon-ja deo i-eo-gan-da. in-gi-tu-pyo ha-myeon je-ga ap-do-jeog-il-geol-yo.
story.en: 'Twin peaks, please, there's no comparison between him and me.' He corrects her quickly, then keeps going with a story nobody asked for. 'If we did a popularity poll, I'd win by a landslide.'

story.text: 아주머니가 웃음을 참으며 '그럼 이 아가씨는 무슨 사이야? 남매 사이라 그런가?' 하고 묻자, 용우가 눈에 띄게 당황하며 딴청을 부린다.
story.reading: a-ju-meo-ni-ga us-eum-eul cham-eu-myeo geu-reom i a-ga-ssi-neun mu-seun sa-i-ya? nam-mae sa-i-ra geu-reon-ga? ha-go mut-ja, yong-u-ga nun-e ttui-ge dang-hwang-ha-myeo ttan-cheong-eul bu-rin-da.
story.en: Holding back a laugh, the ajumma asks, 'Then what's your relationship with this young lady? Is it because you're siblings?' Yongwoo visibly flusters and pretends to be busy with something else.

story.text: '그, 그건 동생이라서 그런 거고…' 얼버무리며 괜히 감귤 상자만 뒤적인다. 귀끝이 빨개져 있었다.
story.reading: geu, geu-geon dong-saeng-i-ra-seo geu-reon geo-go. eol-beo-mu-ri-myeo gwaen-hi gam-gyul sang-ja-man dwi-jeok-in-da. gwi-kkeut-i ppal-gae-jyeo iss-eot-da.
story.en: 'Th-that's because she's my sibling...' He mumbles evasively, fiddling with a box of tangerines for no reason. The tips of his ears had gone red.

story.text: 농장을 나서며 장난스럽게 물었다. '그럼 나 뭐라고 부를 건데?' 용우가 걸음을 멈추더니 한참 만에 입을 뗀다. '…동생 아니면 뭐, 뭐라고 해야 되는데.' '됐다, 신경 쓰지 마라. 그것보다 오늘 대화 몇 개 들려줄 테니까 집중해서 들어봐.'
story.reading: nong-jang-eul na-seo-myeo jang-nan-seu-reop-ge mul-eot-da. geu-reom na mwo-ra-go bu-reul geon-de? yong-u-ga geol-eum-eul meom-chu-deo-ni han-cham man-e ib-eul ttet-da. dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo, mwo-ra-go hae-ya doe-neun-de. dwaet-da, sin-gyeong sseu-ji ma-ra. geu-geot-bo-da o-neul dae-hwa myeot gae deul-lyeo-jul te-ni-kka jip-jung-hae-seo deul-eo-bwa.
story.en: Leaving the orchard, I teasingly asked, 'So what are you going to call me, then?' Yongwoo stopped walking and, after a long pause, finally spoke. '...If not sibling, then what am I even supposed to call you.' 'Forget it, don't worry about it. More importantly, I've got a couple of conversations for you today — listen closely.'

words.example_en: Jeju tangerines have thin skin and a sweet-tart flavor.

words.meaning: Twin peaks (idiom: two rival top figures)
words.example: 그 둘은 회사 내 인기 양대산맥으로 불린다.
words.example_reading: geu dul-eun hoe-sa nae in-gi yang-dae-san-maeg-eu-ro bul-lin-da
words.example_en: The two of them are called the company's twin peaks of popularity.
He was confident his popularity was overwhelmingly ahead.

words.meaning: To mumble a vague answer, evade a question
words.example: 그는 질문에 제대로 답하지 않고 얼버무렸다.
words.example_reading: geu-neun jil-mun-e je-dae-ro dab-a-ji an-go eol-beo-mu-ryeot-da
words.example_en: He didn't answer the question properly and just gave a vague, evasive reply.

words.meaning: To be flustered, embarrassed, caught off guard
words.example_en: He was extremely flustered by the sudden question.

sentences.ko: 농장 아주머니는 그를 규현 기장과 인기 양대산맥이라고 불렀다.
sentences.reading: nong-jang a-ju-meo-ni-neun geu-reul gyu-hyeon gi-jang-gwa in-gi yang-dae-san-maeg-i-ra-go bul-leot-da
sentences.en: The orchard ajumma called him and Captain Kyuhyun the twin peaks of popularity.

sentences.ko: 그는 자기 인기가 압도적으로 더 높다며 재빨리 정정했다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun ja-gi in-gi-ga ap-do-jeog-eu-ro deo nop-da-myeo jae-ppal-li jeong-jeong-haet-da
sentences.en: He quickly corrected her, insisting his popularity was overwhelmingly higher.

sentences.ko: 남자친구가 있냐는 질문에 그는 눈에 띄게 당황했다.
sentences.reading: nam-ja-chin-gu-ga it-nya-neun jil-mun-e geu-neun nun-e ttui-ge dang-hwang-haet-da
sentences.en: Asked whether I had a boyfriend, he was visibly flustered.

sentences.ko: 그는 대답을 얼버무리며 괜히 감귤 상자만 뒤적였다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun dae-dab-eul eol-beo-mu-ri-myeo gwaen-hi gam-gyul sang-ja-man dwi-jeok-yeot-da
sentences.en: He mumbled an evasive answer, fiddling pointlessly with a box of tangerines.

sentences.ko: '동생 아니면 뭐라고 해야 되는데'라는 그의 말이 오래 마음에 남았다.
sentences.reading: dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo-ra-go hae-ya doe-neun-de-ra-neun geu-ui mal-i o-rae ma-eum-e nam-at-da
sentences.en: His words, 'if not sibling, then what am I supposed to call you,' stayed with me for a long time.

turns.speaker: 농장 아주머니
turns.text: 규현 기장이랑 둘이 그렇게 인기가 많다며? 둘이 친해?
turns.reading: gyu-hyeon gi-jang-i-rang dul-i geu-reo-ke in-gi-ga man-ta-myeo? dul-i chin-hae?
turns.en: I hear you and Captain Kyuhyun are both really popular? Are you two close?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 친하긴 한데, 인기를 같이 묶는 건 좀 억울하죠. 급이 다른데.
turns.reading: chin-ha-gin han-de, in-gi-reul gat-i mu-kkeu-neun geon jom eog-ul-ha-jyo. geub-i da-reun-de.
turns.en: We're close, sure, but lumping our popularity together feels a bit unfair. We're on different levels.

turns.speaker: 농장 아주머니
turns.en: You've got quite the competitive streak, young man.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: geu-reon geo a-ni-e-yo. gam-gyul-i-na deo dam-a-deu-ril-ge-yo.
turns.en: ...It's not like that. Let me bag up some more tangerines for you.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 알 수 있는 용우의 성격으로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What does this conversation reveal about Yongwoo's personality?
dialogues.correct_answer: 규현과 비교되는 것에 은근히 승부욕을 보인다
options: 규현과 비교되는 것에 은근히 승부욕을 보인다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 규현과 인기가 같은 급으로 묶이는 걸 못마땅해하며 은근히 승부욕을 드러냈습니다.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 아까 대답 왜 그렇게 얼버무렸어요? 동생 아니면 뭐냐니까.
turns.reading: a-kka dae-dab wae geu-reo-ke eol-beo-mu-ryeoss-eo-yo? dong-saeng a-ni-myeon mwo-nya-ni-kka.
turns.en: Why did you give such a vague answer earlier? You said 'if not sibling, then what.'

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 그, 그건… 나도 잘 모르겠으니까 그렇지.
turns.reading: geu, geu-geon na-do jal mo-reu-gess-eu-ni-kka geu-reo-chi.
turns.en: Th-that's... because I don't really know myself, that's why.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: Is there something even you don't know, Captain?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 있다, 있어. 요즘 자꾸 그런 게 생긴다, 너 때문에.
turns.reading: it-da, iss-eo. yo-jeum ja-kku geu-reon ge saeng-gin-da, neo ttae-mun-e.
turns.en: There is. There is. Lately there's been more and more of that — because of you.

dialogues.question: 이 대화에서 알 수 있는 용우의 심리 상태로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's emotional state in this conversation?
dialogues.correct_answer: 자신의 감정을 스스로도 확신하지 못해 혼란스러워하고 있다
options: 자신의 감정을 스스로도 확신하지 못해 혼란스러워하고 있다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 '동생'이라는 말 대신 뭐라 불러야 할지 스스로도 확신하지 못하며 혼란스러워하고 있습니다.
